svg.title: Two metric stratifications for six pulses
svg.desc: Three-four has three groups of two equal pulses. Six-eight has two groups of three equal pulses. The top grouping differs despite the same pulse count. Ranks for three-four are 5, 0, 3, 1, 4, 2; for six-eight 5, 0, 2, 4, 1, 3.

path.aria-label: Same six pulses, two different meters
The order of the divisions changes where the strongest positions fall.
